issue_catalog.description: First sentence top, continuation bottom splits a single caption system. Seek a unified quiet caption region without covering waterfall.

issue_catalog.title: Inconsistent caption treatment
issue_catalog.description: Second line appears heavier/darker than other story type; firstline carpet/secondline marble complicates grouping. Match normal story weight and readable shared placement.

issue_catalog.description: Current PDF repeats story3; new composition remains outside book. Integrate with spoiler-free copy.

issue_catalog.title: Warm iris drift
issue_catalog.description: Bright amber-orange reads more strongly than chestnut reference; local iris-only repair. Warm highlights elsewhere alone are not a defect.

issue_catalog.title: Resolution/edge uniformity
issue_catalog.description: Small characters/patches softer than surrounding art, plus bath native height below requested minimum. Separate print limitation from visible proof defects.

comparison: Repeated detections are one issue, not multiple defects. No-finding runs are recorded. Small artifacts at native detail and source identity differences outrank cosmetic preference.
